appDescription: Mate lets the driver hand work to an agent on the driver's own cloud computer by voice while driving, then review and approve the result only while the car is stopped.

function.name: DELEGATE_TASK
function.description: Hand a piece of work to the agent on the driver's own cloud computer. The work runs there, not in the car. Returns a job id.

task.description: What the driver asked for, in the driver's own words.

kind.description: proposal: build a proposal page from the last meeting. edit: change the page that was just built. bugfix: fix a bug in the driver's code and publish a preview.

requestId.description: Idempotency key. A retry with the same requestId returns the same job.

function.name: SHOW_RESULT
function.description: Open the result of a finished job on the car screen. Refused while the car is moving.

jobId.description: The job to show. Defaults to the latest finished job.

function.name: APPROVE_DEPLOY
function.description: Approve deploying the fixed code that is waiting for approval. Refused unless the car is stopped (speed 0).

jobId.description: The job to deploy. Defaults to the latest job waiting for approval.

function.name: BRIEF_MY_PROMISES
function.description: Read out the open promises the driver made to other people that are due today.

function.name: ADD_PROMISE
function.description: Save a new promise the driver just made so it is tracked until it is closed.

counterpart.description: The person the promise was made to.

content.description: What the driver promised to do.

dueDateTime.description: When the promise is due, in ISO 8601 date and time format.

function.name: SEND_ARRIVAL_UPDATE
function.description: Send the person waiting at the current destination a short message with the estimated arrival time.

counterpart.description: The person to notify about the arrival time.
